title: Normalized tensor transport on complexes and K-flat localization
statement: Let k0 be a finite field, l a prime invertible in k0, and X any k0-scheme. Fix an additive native bifunctor T, additive in each parameter, with all cochain totals and a parameter adjunction making T(P,-) left adjoint to the specified native internal Hom(P,-). Fix a NativeWeilTensorRingedBridge b [def-sf-native-weil-tensor-ringed-bridge]. Then NativeWeilRingedTensorComplexes b T adj is inhabited: there is an underived comparison E(T(P,Q)) with EQ tensor EP whose inverse is fixed by the tensor-Hom adjunction and b.nativeHom; a natural total-complex comparison with the ringed total of (EQ,EP), with scalar (-1)^(pq) on the (p,q)-summand; transport of native acyclic-test K-flat complexes to ringed acyclic-test K-flat complexes; and localization of all native K-flat complexes at quasi-isomorphisms onto their actual unbounded derived category [def-sf-native-weil-tensor-presentation]. No derived tensor, derived symmetry or forgetting comparison is an input or conclusion.
